name: independent-youtube-playlist-manager
description: Generate YouTube playlists from bookmarks and URL lists
author: el-musleh

scripts.build: cd playlist-editor && npm install && npm run build && cd .. && node scripts/patch-innerhtml.js && npm run build-chrome && npm run build-firefox && node scripts/validate-manifests.js
scripts.build-chrome: [ -f src/manifest.json ] && { echo 'ERROR: src/manifest.json exists — delete it, only templates belong in src/'; exit 1; } || true; mkdir -p dist/chrome && rm -rf dist/chrome/* && cp -r src/* dist/chrome/ && cp src/manifest.chrome.json dist/chrome/manifest.json
scripts.build-firefox: [ -f src/manifest.json ] && { echo 'ERROR: src/manifest.json exists — delete it, only templates belong in src/'; exit 1; } || true; mkdir -p dist/firefox && rm -rf dist/firefox/* && cp -r src/* dist/firefox/ && cp src/manifest.firefox.json dist/firefox/manifest.json
scripts.sign-firefox: bash -c 'set -a && source .env && set +a && npx web-ext sign --source-dir=dist/firefox --artifacts-dir=dist/firefox/web-ext-artifacts --channel=unlisted'
scripts.pack: npm run pack:chrome && npm run pack:firefox
